ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Three identical objects are stacked on a horizontal plane. Object B is subjected to a horizontal pulling force, but all three objects are in a stationary state, as shown in the figure. Which of the following statements is correct? (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: The contact surfaces between B and C, and between C and the horizontal plane, must be rough.

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Three identical objects are stacked on a horizontal plane. Object B is subjected to a horizontal pulling force, but all three objects are in a stationary state, as shown in the figure. Which contact surfaces must be rough?
ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: The contact surfaces between B and C, and between C and the horizontal plane, must be rough.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, three objects are vertically stacked on horizontal ground. The lowest one is object C, and C is in contact with the horizontal plane; object B is placed on the upper surface of C; object A is placed on the upper surface of B. In the figure, a horizontal pulling force F is drawn on object B, directed to the right; all three objects are in a stationary state. Reasoning: First look at A. A is not subjected to an external horizontal force. If there is no friction between A and B, A can still maintain force balance in the horizontal direction, so the A-B contact surface does not necessarily have to be rough. Next look at B. B is subjected to the pulling force F to the right and is stationary, so in the horizontal direction there must be a force to the left to balance F; A cannot provide the necessary horizontal balancing force to B, so this leftward force can only come from the static friction force exerted by C on B. Therefore, the contact surface between B and C must be rough. Finally look at C. B is subjected to a leftward friction force from C, so B exerts a rightward friction force on C. C is also stationary, so C must be subjected to a leftward static friction force from the horizontal plane to balance it. Therefore, the contact surface between C and the horizontal plane must be rough.
